subject: Hybrid webinar: sponsor handoff & encoder test plan
messages:
From: Mike Patel <mike@brightviewmedia.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sponsorships Team <sponsorships@brightviewmedia.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: BrightView sponsor logistics + encoder access for Dec 8th webinar

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for slotting BrightView into the December 8th hybrid session. Couple of quick asks so we can coordinate our sponsor spotlight and the short breakout stream: 

1) Encoder access: our AV partner (EventTech) will need an RTMP endpoint and a test window next week to validate keying/bitrate. Can you confirm who on your side will hand over the stream key and when?
2) Sponsor creative: sending a revised badge pack (attached) — want to confirm safe areas and animation constraints for the lower-third.
3) Recording permissions: do you have a standard consent blurb we should include in the registration confirmation that covers on-demand reuse? Our legal team prefers explicit language.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps.

—Mike
Mike Patel
Director, Partnerships
BrightView Media

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mike Patel <mike@brightviewmedia.com>, James Crowley <james.crowley@eventtech.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: BrightView sponsor logistics + encoder access for Dec 8th webinar

Hi Mike —

Thanks — great questions. Quick responses below and a proposed test schedule at the bottom.

1) Encoder / RTMP: we will provide a temporary stream key for the rehearsal window and then a production key for the actual event. Ben (cc'd, Platform Ops) will provision both keys in our Zoom/ON24 bridge and share them via a short-lived secure link. James from EventTech, we should target Wednesday 12/2 for a dry-run at 10:00 PT.

2) Creative: the attached badge looks fine. Marissa, can you confirm the lower-third safe area and whether we need a static PNG or animated MP4? We avoid alpha channels in the main compositor.

3) Recording/consent: below is the standard wording we use in registration confirmations — happy to modify for legal.

"By registering you consent to be recorded. The recording may be shared on-demand with attendees and used in marketing materials by Redwood Inference and event partners. If you have concerns about personal data in Q&A, please contact privacy@redwoodinference.com."

Proposed schedule:
- Wed 2026-12-02 10:00 PT — EventTech & Redwood dry-run (RTMP push + lower-third check)
- Thu 2026-12-03 09:00 PT — Quick walkthrough with Sponsor creative and run-of-show
- Tue 2026-12-08 10:45 PT — Sponsor handoff 10 min before the main session starts

Attachments: sponsor_badges_v2.png (from Mike), draft encoder config (see Ben).

If that works, Ben can send the secure key link after the rehearsal is confirmed.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Field Marketing Manager | Redwood Inference

From: James Crowley <james.crowley@eventtech.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Mike Patel <mike@brightviewmedia.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Re: BrightView sponsor logistics + encoder access for Dec 8th webinar

Hi all —

Wed 12/2 10:00 PT works for EventTech. We'll run a 25-minute checklist: encoder handshake, keyframe intervals, audio level normalization, and verifying the sponsor lower-third safe areas when we push graphics. Can Ben send the encoder footprint/settings so we can pre-configure? Also, do you prefer we use the ON24 encoder or push directly into Zoom and then route to ON24? Our recommendation is to push to Zoom for the live interactive portion and a direct feed to ON24 for the on-demand archive to avoid double-encoding.

Thanks,
James
James Crowley
Technical Producer, EventTech

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: BrightView sponsor logistics + encoder access for Dec 8th webinar

Team —

Sending over the prod encoder footprint we plan to use. Key points:
- RTMP endpoints: we will provide two short-lived keys (rehearsal, production). Keys will be valid only from the scheduled time windows.
- Bitrate: 6 Mbps target, fallback profiles to 4 Mbps for redundancy.
- Keyframe: 2s; GOP aligned to 60 fps when available.
- Audio: 48kHz, -6dB nominal level.
- Graphic inputs: send lower-third as non-alpha MP4 or static PNG; safe area is 120 px from bottom on 1080p.

I attached encoder_config_prod.txt with the exact parameters. James, pushing to Zoom as primary and direct to ON24 for archive sounds good — we have a bridge that handles splitting the feeds. We'll test that in the dry-run.

Ben Carter
Platform Operations | Redwood Inference
